verdict.rationale: Licensing terms are a fair question for any self-hosted AI runtime, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack states LocalAI's license or whether commercial or enterprise use needs a paid tier. The phrase "one open runtime" is marketing wording, not a documented license or commercial-use policy.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
